transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I guess the main thing is I’m just not sleeping right. That’s what finally made me call the employee assistance program. I’ll lie there replaying work stuff and arguments at home, then I wake up around 3 or 4 in the morning and can’t really get back to sleep. So I start the day feeling like I never actually rested.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things, not just sleep?
I’m not sure I’d say it’s a lot of different things. It’s mostly the stuff I mentioned—work and some tension at home. I don’t know that I worry about everything, though.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… I have. Most days there’s just this heavy, gray feeling that kind of follows me around—from work to the car, then home. Even when nothing in particular is happening, I just feel kind of hollow.
Have you been enjoying things less than you usually do?

Yeah, definitely. I used to look forward to things like pickup basketball, bowling nights, going to music festivals, even having people over and firing up the smoker. Lately I either cancel, or if I do go, I’m kind of just there… going through the motions.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But… yeah, the thought comes up sometimes that maybe everyone would be better off if I just didn’t wake up one morning. More than I really want to admit.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah. It’s been harder than usual. I used to be able to knock out sales forecasts or client decks pretty quickly, but now I’ll read the same slide over and over, second-guess the numbers, and still feel stuck on what to say.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?

Yeah, my appetite’s been off for a while. I’ll kind of run on coffee and skip lunch without really meaning to, then at dinner I just pick at what’s there. But somehow I’ve still noticed my belt’s a notch tighter than it used to be.
Did these problems start after a specific stressful event or change in your life?
Yeah… I’d say it started after things at home got worse. The arguments have been going on for about a year and a couple months now, and that’s around when I noticed I started feeling like this.
Have you been feeling this depressed nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes. It’s been most days, definitely more than two weeks. It’s like this heavy, gray feeling follows me around—from work to the car to home—and even when nothing is really happening, I just feel kind of hollow.
When something genuinely good happens, does your mood lift at all, even briefly?

Maybe a little, but it doesn’t last. Even if something good happens, I still feel that same heavy, gray feeling most of the day. It’s like it follows me from work to the car to home, and then I’m just kind of hollow again.
Have you been moving or talking noticeably slower than usual?

Yeah… somewhat. I don’t think people at work would say I’m falling apart or anything, but I notice it. I move slower, and I’ll sit there staring at my laptop longer than I should. Sometimes one of my reps asks me something simple and I take a beat too long to answer.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel kind of worn down, but I haven’t specifically been tracking my energy or anything. It’s hard to tell what’s tired versus just… not feeling like myself.
If the arguments at home ease up for a day or two, do you still feel depressed?

Yeah. Even if things are quiet at home for a day or two, it doesn’t really go away. Most days it’s just this heavy, gray mood that kind of follows me around—from work to the car to home—and even when nothing specific is happening, I still feel pretty hollow.
Has this been interfering with how you function at work or at home?

Yeah, it has. I’m still getting to work and doing the basics, but I’m slipping on things I normally stay on top of, like forecasts and prep for client calls. My team has had to cover some of those gaps.

And at home… I’m there, but I’m not as present with my wife and kids as I used to be.
Have you gained weight recently without trying to?

Yeah, a little, I think. I haven’t been trying to, but my belt’s definitely a notch tighter than it used to be. My eating’s been kind of off too—I’ll just have coffee and skip lunch, barely pick at dinner, and somehow I’ve still put on some weight.
